basic_info.description: This well-maintained Edwardian-style 6-unit building, located in the highly desirable heart of the Castro, offers an excellent investment opportunity. The building consists of 5 two-bedroom, one-bath units and 1 three-bedroom, two-bath unit, all fully rented. This totals 13 bedrooms and 7 bathrooms. 4 of the units have been updated with modern finishes, while 2 units are in their original condition with long-term tenants. With its prime location, steady rental income, and potential for future appreciation, this is a great opportunity for investors looking to own a well-maintained property in one of San Francisco's most desirable areas. Yearly Income:$237,771; Expenses:(Utilities, Management fees, Maintenance, etc.):$32,486. Current insurance $7,819; property taxes @ 1.8% of Asking price=$28,261.
